challenge: C02 Severe Class Imbalance / Rare-Event Stress (99:1)
data_source: SYNTHETIC - disclosure features are generated from hand-chosen distributions; no real labelled greenwashing dataset is used. Results prove the evaluation harness and imbalance handling, not real-world detection accuracy.
methodology: 5 random seeds x 5,000 eval samples each, 1% positives
detector: IsolationForest(200 trees) anomaly score, unsupervised fit
verdict: [Synthetic data] Across 5 seeds at 99:1 skew: PR-AUC 0.958 ± 0.021 vs random-guess baseline 0.010. A useless approve-everything model hits 99% accuracy — we measure PR-AUC instead, so collapse is impossible to hide. At a 1% audit budget, 90% of flagged cases are true fraud (90x lift).
